utterances.text: And I'm not going to talk about your background at all, Mr. Blaszczyk, because we talked about that when you testified on 20th of August, 2010, when you were here before. So now talking about what I'll call the road book, can you tell us very briefly, and for the record you have a copy in front of you, what is this document? What does it show us?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Recalled]
utterances.text: This road book or Petrovic video book we created based on Mr. Petrovic Pirocanac's video raw material and also of the material broadcasted by Serbian television and Studio B television in July 1995. This road book contains a map of particular area of Bratunac, in fact, Potocari, Sandici, Kravica, Pervani, Lolici, and the pictures, the stills from the material broadcasted by Serbian television in July 1995. The material was recorded by Serbian journalist Zoran Petrovic. And also in this notebook -- this road book, I -- we attached the pictures of the spotted location of this aerial -- of this area I mentioned just while before.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Thank you. And you said that --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Microphone, Mr. Nicholls.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: And you said, Mr. Blaszczyk, that Zoran Petrovic Pirocanac, shot this raw video footage that's the subject of the book as well as created the Studio B documentary. Can you tell us what dates Mr. Petrovic Pirocanac shot this footage in the areas you described?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Recalled]
utterances.text: The footage was recorded on the 13 and 14 July 1995 on the area -- area I described just while ago. It's Potocari, Sandici, Kravica and Pervani area.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: And just to be clear, this man's name is Zoran Petrovic. Is Pirocanac a nickname which is sometimes used and attached to his full name?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Recalled]
utterances.text: It is correct. His real name is Zoran Petrovic but he use nickname of Pirocanac.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: And we'll look at the video later, but could you also tell us and tell Their Honours in the back of 65 ter 03931, the Petrovic video road book, there's a CV -- or DVD. Can you just tell us what that is in the back?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Recalled]
utterances.text: To each notebook we attached digital presentation of the same area. In fact, digital presentation containing only information about Potocari, and Sandici and Kravica area. It's more or less is the same -- the same presentation like is in the book but more widely described, more accessible. If we're going to play this presentation, I will explain everything in due course.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Thank you. And now just before we get on to the book, we'll see in the video that Mr. Petrovic Pirocanac travelled by car in the areas you've mapped out and took some video actually from the moving car on the 13 and 14 July. Who was with him during his trip to these areas? Who else was present in the vehicle?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Recalled]
utterances.text: Mr. Zoran Petrovic Pirocanac is travelling together with Ljubisa Borovcanin and with his driver. I mean Ljubomir Borovcanin's driver. I think his name is Nedjo Jovicic.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: And just for our record, who is Mr. Borovcanin?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Recalled]
utterances.text: At that -- at that time Mr. Ljubomir Borovcanin was the deputy commander of the Special Police Brigade of Republika Srpska.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Thank you. The video footage which was used in comprising this book, where did it come from? Where did -- how did you receive it? And I'm talking there about the video with the ERN V000-6747, which is P00667, previously admitted.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Recalled]
utterances.text: Regarding to this particular video, this is copy of the raw material that Mr. Pirocanac or Petrovic recorded in -- at that time in July 1995 in Srebrenica area. Mr. Petrovic gave us access to this raw material in 2006 - I think it was February 2006 - during the interview we had conducted with him in our field office in Belgrade. We made a copy there, a good quality copy, the best quality copy we could, you know, just of this material from him. And on the copy he confirmed that the tape contained exactly the same -- the same footage he recorded on the raw material.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Okay. And just if I can be clear, is it right then that Mr. Petrovic Pirocanac personally handed you his raw material, that you were present when the OTP copied that raw material, and that then Mr. Pirocanac certified that the copy was a good correct copy?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Recalled]
utterances.text: Yes, this is correct. You know, just when we met Mr. Pirocanac in February 2006 we asked him to provide the raw material, his raw material. He agreed with it. I remember at that time he didn't have this material with him. I had to drive him to his accommodation in Belgrade and we picked up the raw material. We returned to our field office and our video assistant who also assisted us in -- during this mission he made the copy of -- of this raw material, in fact, with our presence, with presence my lawyer, it was Mr. Nicholls at that time, and Mr. Petrovic.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Thank you. Now, very briefly, has the OTP come into possession of any other versions, any other tapes, of this raw material from other sources?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Recalled]
utterances.text: Yes. The OTP is in possession also of other of, let's say, the copy of the same material but from other sources -- our sources. This would be -- this is, in fact, material we received from -- from BBC, it was 2002. Then the material we received -- we are talking about copy of the raw material from Mr. Pirocanac, the material we received from -- from Ministry of Defence of Bosnia-Herzegovina. I think it was 2007. And -- and we have also added the material which was broadcasted by Studio B in July 1995 containing the footage from Petrovic raw material. Well, edited version. We receive it from Mr. Ljubisa Borovcanin during the interview we had with him. As far as I remember, it was March 2002.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Could I please have 65 ter 03933. And to save time while it's coming up I'll say this is a document from the VRS Main Staff Centre for Information and Propaganda Activities, dated the 22nd of June, 1996, signed by Colonel Milovan Milutinovic. And it's entitled: "Report on television footage from Srebrenica, VRS Main Staff Security Body." And if we could just scroll down to see the signature, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Now, Mr. Blaszczyk, who is -- or in July 1995, what was the position for Colonel Milutinovic in the VRS?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Recalled]
utterances.text: In July 1995, Colonel Milan Milutinovic was the head of the press centre of VRS.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: And very briefly, you've seen this document before; correct?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Recalled]
utterances.text: Yes, it is correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: And just to sum up, this refers to the Petrovic Pirocanac raw material being in Belgrade and states that it should be obtained by the VRS.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Recalled]
utterances.text: Yes. That is correct, yes. Exactly.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: May I tender that document, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Exhibit P4266, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: We still have time. Could I please have 65 ter 03934 in e-court, a document dated 24 June 1996, receipt for temporarily seized object, signed by Naval Captain Ljubisa Beara.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: And in the document we just saw signed by Colonel Milutinovic, he stated that a receipt would be necessary. Can you just tell us, first of all, what was Ljubisa Beara's position in July 1995 in the VRS?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Recalled]
utterances.text: Ljubisa Beara in July 1995 and during entire the war in Bosnia-Herzegovina was head of security administration in Main Staff of Army of Republika Srpska.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: And just -- can you tell us, did these documents play any role in the OTP's obtaining the version of the Petrovic Pirocanac raw video which you alluded to that we received from the Ministry of Defence of the RS?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Recalled]
utterances.text: Yes. We first -- if I may explain how we received these documents first. First we received -- in fact, our team from The Hague went to Banja Luka to the barracks in Banja Luka. I think it was 2006, November or October in 2006, and they got access to the archive of the Main Staff of army of -- to -- to the archive of the Army of Republika Srpska in Banja Luka, and they copied some -- they scanned some documents, lot of material from -- from the archive. When -- later on when the team return to The Hague, we had -- and all the scanned versions of the documents were put in -- in our system and were accessible for all investigators, we started to review all the documents, and during the reviewing all this stuffs, at that time scanned in barracks of Army of Republika Srpska, we discovered these two documents. This is information of Colonel Milutinovic and also receipt for temporarily seized object, the tape, signed by Colonel Ljubisa Beara, but we received a copy of these documents -- I mean the scanned version of these documents. Immediately when we discovered these receipts, we requested again Ministry of Defence of Bosnia-Herzegovina for the originals of these documents and also we requested for the tape which is mentioned in both documents.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Okay. And just quickly, you said, when you were talking about this archive: "At first we received access to the archive of the Main Staff of the army," and then you said, "to the Army of Republika Srpska in Banja Luka." Which archive was this in Banja Luka?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Recalled]
utterances.text: It was -- it was archive of the Army of Republika -- Republika Srpska, but personally I don't believe that it was entire archive of the Main Staff. It's rather not, you know, just -- but there were documents from various corps and, yes, they were documents from Army of Republika Srpska.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Mr. Nicholls, I note the time.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Yeah. May I tender the document, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: And that's a good place to break.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Exhibit P4267, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Having realised where we are now, I now find out that we didn't have to take a break for the preparation.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: No, Your Honours. In fact, we --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: The previous video we admitted as Petrovic video was admitted as part of associate exhibit of Mr. Petrovic.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Correct, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Can I have the exhibit number of Mr. Zoran Petrovic's statement or testimony?

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: I'll have to look that up, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: I'm sorry, I don't have that at my fingertips.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Very well. We'll adjourn for today and resume tomorrow at 9.00.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: May I just clarify one thing?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: Mr. Petrovic didn't testify in this.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: We admitted his evidence pursuant to Rule 92 bis. That was my -- that was my question. I was told that it is Exhibit P375, under seal.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Correct. That's correct. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you. Tomorrow, 9.00.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Wednesday, the 25th day of January, 2012, at 9.00 a.m. 20 21 22 23 24 25
